# BEWT-CovExt Sprint 03 — AI Selenium Generation and E2E Validation

**Status: PARTIAL / BLOCKED.** Team Lead decisions were recorded; four accepted candidates were generated by Gemini inside LangGraph, repaired, compiled, and run once each. No application assertion passed because the app or required fixtures were unavailable. No commit or push was made.

## Team Lead decisions recorded

Updated [Sprint 02 decision record](../sprint-02/human-review-decisions.json) without changing its structure. Reviewer is Team Lead; no personal identity or signature was invented. EC-C01, EC-C02, EC-C04, and EC-C05 are ACCEPT for implementation. EC-C03 remains REVISE. Acceptance does not claim E2E PASS or empirical novelty.

## Source and runtime

- ExpressCart source: mrvautin/expressCart, commit b31302f4e99c3293bd742c6d076a721e168118b0, package version 1.1.19.
- Java 21.0.12; Maven 3.9.16; Selenium 4.35.0; JUnit 4.12; Chrome 156.0.8078.76; ChromeDriver 156.0.8078.80.
- Selenium warned that its 4.35.0 CDP module does not match Chrome 156. Chrome/ChromeDriver did start outside the sandbox, so the warning did not itself prevent test execution.
- Docker daemon was unavailable: Docker Desktop Linux-engine named pipe did not exist, executable at the standard Docker Desktop path was absent, and http://127.0.0.1:3111 returned connection refused. Docker service state is NOT_VERIFIED because Service Control Manager access was denied. No container was created or started. The pinned Compose file declares project bewt-covext-expresscart-b31302f, internal experiment network, four named volumes, loopback-only app port 3111, and MongoDB 4.4.29. Actual Docker volume ownership and image digests remain NOT_VERIFIED.

## AI generation and repair

The official final classes are in [generation/langgraph-run/](generation/langgraph-run/). The LangGraph node generate_java performed the four Gemini calls in the requested order: EC-C02 EmptyCartTest, EC-C04 ForgottenPasswordTest, EC-C01 RemoveDiscountCodeTest, EC-C05 CreateStaticPageTest. Each candidate has a saved prompt containing its accepted Gherkin and baseline comparison, a structured model response with usage metadata, and Java source. These sources were copied into the isolated Maven suite.

A first compile attempt failed at module level with API mismatches specifically in EC-C04 and EC-C05. LangGraph repair iteration 1 fixed those contracts and test-compile passed. Source review found additional issues in EC-C02 (missing initial empty-cart assertion), EC-C01 (reflection-based URL resolution instead of BaseTest.appUrl), and EC-C05 (cleanup used a slug not displayed in the admin list); repair iteration 2 addressed those. The final compile passed after the second repair. Per-candidate prompts/responses and [langgraph-repair-history.json](langgraph-repair-history.json) preserve this sequence.

During final audit I found that an earlier implementation had invoked Gemini outside the graph and only used LangGraph to write its manifest. Those 4 generated classes, 12 model responses, 8 prior repair calls, and their run evidence remain under generation/ and e2e/ as superseded history; they are excluded from official candidate pass metrics. The official final source is the later generation/langgraph-run/ output, whose Gemini calls occurred inside LangGraph. No dependency was upgraded.

## Compilation results

| Stage | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| First compile of official LangGraph source | FAIL at Maven module level; compiler identified BaseTest/AdminLoginPage API mismatches in EC-C04/EC-C05 | [compilation-langgraph-first-attempt.log](compilation-langgraph-first-attempt.log) |
| Compile after repair 1 | PASS | [compilation-langgraph-after-repair1.log](compilation-langgraph-after-repair1.log) |
| Compile after repair 2 | PASS; 38 source files compiled | [compilation-langgraph-final.log](compilation-langgraph-final.log) |
| Agent TypeScript build | PASS (npm run build) | [agent-build.log](agent-build.log) |

The Maven compiler builds the suite as a module; therefore first-attempt success was not isolated per test class. The module failed on the initial attempt and all four final Java classes compiled after repairs. Repair iterations used were EC-C02: 1, EC-C04: 1, EC-C01: 1, EC-C05: 2; no candidate exceeded the two-iteration limit.

## E2E results

Pre-repair E2E was NOT_RUN because the first compile failed. After compilation and source repairs, four test invocations ran sequentially outside the sandbox. This was each candidate's first runnable E2E attempt and also the final attempt; no E2E-driven repair followed it. Surefire XML/text, console logs, and four screenshots are under [e2e/langgraph-final/](e2e/langgraph-final/).

| ID | Surefire tests | Pass | Failure | Error | Classification |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| EC-C02 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 | Environment: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED opening app URL |
| EC-C04 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 | Environment: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED opening forgotten-password URL |
| EC-C01 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | Test fixture: test.discount.code was not configured; test stopped at precondition |
| EC-C05 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | Environment/test config: ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD were absent; test stopped before app navigation |

Final E2E: 4 candidates invoked, 0 PASS, 2 Selenium errors, 2 precondition failures. All four are classified BLOCKED by app/configuration prerequisites; none reached an application behavior oracle. No business data was written, and no cleanup/reset behavior was exercised or verified. Three clean-state repetitions were not run because no test passed and no reset was confirmed.

## Changes and limits

No file under bewt-original/ was modified. Sprint 01 and Sprint 02 evidence is preserved except the requested Team Lead decision record. No Docker resource was created, started, reset, or removed. No test completed a business write. No secrets were added to reports. Official generated classes and LangGraph generation/repair scripts are in the experiment workspace; dependencies were not changed. No commit or push occurred.

## Required conditions to continue

1. Make the Docker daemon available and start only the pinned isolated Compose project; verify fresh data and ownership before any reset.
2. Configure the authorized discount/cart/payment fixture through the approved environment/test-data mechanism; keep coupon values out of reports.
3. Supply admin test credentials through environment variables for EC-C05; do not commit them.
4. Have Team Lead review the EC-C03 revision separately.
5. Rerun the four candidates serially, verify cleanup/reset, then run three clean-state repetitions for each candidate that passes.

The environment is not ready for research execution, and the acceptance criteria for a clean reset, E2E pass, and repeatability remain unverified.
